description: Myanmar - village tract boundary is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Boundaries", published or maintained by Columbia University Earth Institute. Village tract boundary (polygons) for Myanmar. The data is curated from Myanmar Information Management Unit. For details please visit. Coverage: Myanmar. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Boundaries. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
